country.match: Match each director to their country.
country.odd: Three of these directors are from {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Guy Ritchie
rows.hook: made slick crime capers about fast-talking gangsters and directed a modern Sherlock Holmes

rows.label: Warren Beatty
rows.hook: starred in and directed a film about a comic-strip detective, and once opened the wrong Oscars envelope

rows.label: Sylvester Stallone
rows.hook: wrote and starred as an underdog boxer who runs up the steps of a Philadelphia museum

rows.label: Clint Eastwood
rows.hook: played a squinting gunslinger called the Man with No Name before directing Oscar-winning westerns

rows.label: Kenneth Branagh
rows.hook: brought many Shakespeare plays to the screen and played the detective Hercule Poirot on film

rows.label: Ben Affleck
rows.description: American film actor, director and screenwriter (born 1972)
rows.hook: directed a Boston heist thriller and also played Batman on the big screen

rows.label: Rob Reiner
rows.hook: directed a mockumentary about a loud heavy-metal band whose amplifiers go up to eleven

rows.label: Steven Spielberg
rows.hook: directed a shark thriller, a dinosaur theme-park adventure and a story of a friendly alien stranded on Earth

rows.label: George Lucas
rows.hook: created a space saga about Jedi knights, a farm boy named Luke and a villain in a black helmet

rows.label: Danny DeVito
rows.description: American actor, comedian, director and producer (born 1944)
rows.hook: played a cranky taxi dispatcher on a sitcom and the scheming Penguin in a Batman film

rows.label: Seth MacFarlane
rows.hook: created a cartoon about a bumbling dad and a talking dog, and directed a film about a living teddy bear

rows.label: Ridley Scott
rows.hook: directed a sci-fi horror with a deadly xenomorph, a gladiator epic and a cyberpunk noir

rows.label: Quentin Tarantino
rows.hook: is known for talky, nonlinear crime films such as Pulp Fiction and Reservoir Dogs

rows.label: Robert Redford
rows.hook: starred as the Sundance Kid and founded a famous independent film festival in Utah

rows.label: John Krasinski
rows.hook: played Jim on a paper-company sitcom, then directed a horror film where monsters hunt by sound

rows.label: Kevin Costner
rows.hook: starred in a baseball fantasy about a cornfield diamond and won an Oscar directing a frontier epic

rows.label: David Lynch
rows.hook: created a surreal TV mystery that asked who killed Laura Palmer

rows.label: Barbra Streisand
rows.hook: is a legendary singer who starred in Funny Girl and won Oscars for acting and songwriting

rows.label: Jodie Foster
rows.hook: played an FBI trainee who trades riddles with a cannibal psychiatrist in a thriller

rows.label: James Gunn
rows.hook: directed a space adventure about a ragtag band of misfits with a talking raccoon and a walking tree

rows.label: Mel Brooks
rows.hook: spoofed westerns and horror movies with Blazing Saddles and Young Frankenstein

rows.label: Jordan Peele
rows.hook: made a hit horror film about a visit to a girlfriend's family and a place called the sunken place

rows.label: Ben Stiller
rows.hook: directed and starred as a dim male model in a fashion-world comedy

rows.label: Francis Ford Coppola
rows.hook: directed a mafia saga about the Corleone family and an offer that can't be refused

rows.label: Ron Howard
rows.description: American film director, producer, and actor
rows.hook: grew up as Opie on a small-town sitcom and went on to direct Apollo 13

rows.label: David Fincher
rows.hook: directed dark, stylish thrillers like Seven and Fight Club

rows.label: Tim Burton
rows.hook: makes gothic, quirky films like Edward Scissorhands and Beetlejuice

rows.label: Werner Herzog
rows.description: German film director, producer, screenwriter, actor and opera director (born 1942)
rows.hook: is famed for intense documentaries and for once eating his own shoe after losing a bet

rows.label: Paul Thomas Anderson
rows.hook: directed the oil-tycoon drama with the famous line about drinking your milkshake

rows.label: Jon Favreau
rows.hook: directed the first Iron Man film and the holiday comedy about a human raised as an elf

rows.label: Elizabeth Banks
rows.hook: played Effie Trinket in The Hunger Games and directed Pitch Perfect 2

rows.label: Orson Welles
rows.hook: made Citizen Kane and panicked radio listeners with a Martians-invade broadcast

rows.label: J. J. Abrams
rows.hook: created the plane-crash island TV series Lost and directed a Star Wars sequel

rows.label: Taika Waititi
rows.description: New Zealand filmmaker, actor, and comedian (born 1975)
rows.hook: directed a god-of-thunder superhero comedy and voiced a gentle rock creature in it

rows.label: Dennis Hopper
rows.hook: rode motorcycles in a famous counterculture road movie that he also directed

rows.label: Mira Nair
rows.hook: directed Monsoon Wedding, a lively film about a Punjabi family wedding in Delhi

rows.label: Sofia Coppola
rows.hook: directed a dreamy film about two strangers in a Tokyo hotel and won an Oscar for her screenplay

rows.label: John Carpenter
rows.hook: directed the classic slasher film about a masked killer stalking a town on Halloween night

rows.label: Sam Raimi
rows.hook: directed the Spider-Man trilogy starring Tobey Maguire

rows.label: Zack Snyder
rows.hook: directed stylized action films about 300 Spartans and the Man of Steel

rows.label: Greta Gerwig
rows.hook: directed Lady Bird and a hit movie about a fashion doll

rows.label: Denis Villeneuve
rows.hook: directed the Dune films and the sequel to Blade Runner

rows.label: Wes Anderson
rows.hook: is known for symmetrical, pastel-colored films like The Grand Budapest Hotel

rows.label: Richard Attenborough
rows.hook: won Oscars for directing Gandhi and played the founder of a dinosaur park

rows.label: Rob Zombie
rows.hook: fronted a shock-rock band before directing horror films

rows.label: Guillermo del Toro
rows.hook: directed a fantasy about a girl in a faun's labyrinth and an Oscar-winning fish-man romance

rows.label: Hayao Miyazaki
rows.hook: co-founded Studio Ghibli and made Spirited Away and My Neighbor Totoro

rows.label: Laurence Olivier
rows.hook: was a legendary stage actor who filmed Hamlet and Henry V and was made a lord

rows.label: John Waters
rows.description: American filmmaker, actor, comedian and writer (born 1946)
rows.hook: is the pencil-mustached cult filmmaker behind the musical Hairspray

rows.label: Spike Lee
rows.hook: directed Do the Right Thing and is a famous courtside fan of the New York Knicks

rows.label: David Cronenberg
rows.hook: is the master of body horror behind the film about a scientist who merges with a fly

rows.label: Spike Jonze
rows.hook: directed Being John Malkovich and a film about a man who falls for his computer's voice

rows.label: Peter Jackson
rows.description: New Zealand film director, screenwriter, producer and actor (born 1961)
rows.hook: brought Middle-earth to the screen with the Lord of the Rings trilogy

rows.label: Sam Mendes
rows.hook: directed the Bond films Skyfall and Spectre, and the suburban drama American Beauty

rows.label: Bob Fosse
rows.hook: choreographed and directed Cabaret and the dance musical All That Jazz

rows.label: Farhan Akhtar
rows.hook: directed the Bollywood friends-on-a-Goa-trip film Dil Chahta Hai and played a famous runner onscreen

rows.label: Trey Parker
rows.hook: co-created a crude cartoon about foul-mouthed kids in a Colorado mountain town

rows.label: Brian De Palma
rows.hook: directed the prom-night horror film Carrie and the first Mission: Impossible

rows.label: Eli Roth
rows.hook: directed horror films and played the bat-swinging Bear Jew in a World War II caper

rows.label: Danny Boyle
rows.hook: directed Trainspotting and the Oscar-winning Slumdog Millionaire

rows.label: Harold Ramis
rows.hook: directed a comedy about a weatherman reliving the same day and played one of the Ghostbusters

rows.label: Michael Bay
rows.hook: is known for loud, explosive blockbusters about giant transforming robots

rows.label: Penny Marshall
rows.hook: directed a comedy about a boy who wakes up as an adult and a film about a women's baseball league

rows.label: Gene Kelly
rows.description: American dancer, actor, singer, director and choreographer (1912–1996)
rows.hook: danced and sang through puddles in the rain while swinging an umbrella

rows.label: Nora Ephron
rows.hook: directed a romantic comedy about a widower, a radio call-in show and a meeting atop the Empire State Building

rows.label: Robert Zemeckis
rows.description: American screenwriter, film producer and director (born 1952)
rows.hook: directed a time-traveling DeLorean adventure and a film mixing cartoon characters with live actors

rows.label: Brad Bird
rows.description: American film director, animator, screenwriter and producer (born 1957)
rows.hook: directed animated films about a rat who loves cooking and a family of superheroes

rows.label: Paul Greengrass
rows.hook: directed shaky-camera action thrillers starring an amnesiac spy named Bourne

rows.label: Tony Goldwyn
rows.hook: played the scheming best friend in a ghost romance famous for a pottery scene

rows.label: Ryan Coogler
rows.hook: directed a superhero film set in Wakanda and a boxing spin-off about Rocky's protege

rows.label: John Cassavetes
rows.description: Greek-American actor, film director, and screenwriter (1929–1989)
rows.hook: championed improvised independent filmmaking and acted in a horror film about a devil's child

rows.label: John Landis
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter and producer
rows.hook: directed a famous zombie-dance music video and a campus toga-party comedy

rows.label: Kevin Smith
rows.hook: made slacker comedies about convenience store clerks and plays the silent sidekick Bob

rows.label: Luca Guadagnino
rows.hook: directed a sun-soaked summer romance famous for a peach scene

rows.label: John Hughes
rows.hook: made teen comedies about Saturday detention and a student skipping school for a day

rows.label: Michael Mann
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter, and producer (born 1943)
rows.hook: directed a crime epic where two famous actors finally meet across a diner table

rows.label: Richard Linklater
rows.hook: filmed one boy growing up over twelve real years of shooting

rows.label: Yorgos Lanthimos
rows.hook: directs darkly comic oddities about a queen's rival favorites and a woman with a transplanted brain

rows.label: Robert Rodriguez
rows.hook: directed a mariachi action film on a tiny budget and a kids' spy franchise

rows.label: Steven Soderbergh
rows.hook: directed a casino heist caper with a slick crew of eleven and a legal drama about a fighter against polluters

rows.label: Alfonso Cuarón
rows.hook: directed a space-drift survival thriller and a wizard-school prisoner sequel

rows.label: Buster Keaton
rows.description: American motion picture director, motion picture producer, motion picture producers and director, comedian, actor
rows.hook: was the stone-faced silent comedian who performed his own dangerous stunts

rows.label: Chris Columbus
rows.hook: directed a boy left behind over Christmas and the first two wizard-school films

rows.label: Bong Joon-ho
rows.hook: directed the first non-English film to win Best Picture, a dark story of two households divided by class

rows.label: Sydney Pollack
rows.description: American film director, producer and actor (1934-2008)
rows.hook: directed a comedy about an actor posing as a woman and a romance on an African coffee farm

rows.label: John Huston
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter, and actor (1906–1987)
rows.hook: directed a noir about a jeweled bird statue and a prospectors' gold-rush tragedy

rows.label: John Lasseter
rows.description: American animator, film director, screenwriter, producer (born 1957)
rows.hook: led the early animated films about living toys and a lightning-fast race car

rows.label: Kathryn Bigelow
rows.hook: became the first woman to win the Best Director Oscar, for a bomb-disposal war film

rows.label: Louis Malle
rows.description: French film director, screenwriter, and producer (1932-1995)
rows.hook: directed a film that is nothing but two men talking over dinner and a wartime boarding-school drama

rows.label: Farah Khan
rows.hook: choreographs and directs big song-and-dance Bollywood entertainers

rows.label: Ingmar Bergman
rows.hook: directed a film in which a knight plays chess against Death

rows.label: Lars von Trier
rows.hook: co-founded the Dogme filmmaking movement of stripped-down rules

rows.label: Sidney Lumet
rows.hook: directed a tense jury-room drama and a sweaty bank-heist film starring Al Pacino

rows.label: Ang Lee
rows.description: Taiwanese film director, screenwriter and producer (born 1954)
rows.hook: directed a forbidden romance between two cowboys and a martial-arts epic with a crouching tiger

rows.label: Wes Craven
rows.hook: created a dream-invading killer with a razor glove and a masked phone-call slasher series

rows.label: Matthew Vaughn
rows.description: British film producer, director and screenwriter
rows.hook: directed a stylish spy film set around a tailor shop and a superhero film about a girl called Hit-Girl

rows.label: Adam McKay
rows.hook: directed a news-anchor comedy and a film explaining the housing crash with celebrities in bathtubs

rows.label: Paul Verhoeven
rows.hook: directed satirical sci-fi about a cyborg police officer and a war against giant bugs

rows.label: Park Chan-wook
rows.hook: directed a revenge thriller famous for a long hallway hammer fight

rows.label: Mike Nichols
rows.hook: directed a college graduate's affair with the older Mrs. Robinson

rows.label: William Friedkin
rows.hook: directed a horror film about a possessed girl and a gritty New York car-chase cop film

rows.label: Karan Johar
rows.hook: directs glossy Bollywood family romances and hosts a celebrity coffee couch chat show

rows.label: Peter Bogdanovich
rows.hook: directed a black-and-white drama about teenagers in a dying small town with a movie theater

rows.label: Satyajit Ray
rows.hook: made a trilogy following a village boy named Apu

rows.label: Tony Richardson
rows.description: English theatre and film director and producer (1928-1991)
rows.hook: directed a bawdy 18th-century romp about a foundling that won Best Picture

rows.label: Baz Luhrmann
rows.hook: directed a flashy Parisian nightclub musical and a lavish Jazz Age tale of a mysterious millionaire

rows.label: Terrence Malick
rows.hook: directs dreamy, nature-soaked films and is famous for being reclusive

rows.label: Pedro Almodóvar
rows.hook: directs colorful melodramas like one about women on the verge of a nervous breakdown

rows.label: Michael Cimino
rows.hook: directed a steel-town war drama with a Russian roulette scene and a famously over-budget western

rows.label: Jim Jarmusch
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter and actor
rows.hook: makes deadpan indie films, including one about vampire lovers and another about five taxi rides

rows.label: Sean Baker
rows.hook: directed a Best Picture winner about a dancer's whirlwind marriage to an oligarch's son

rows.label: Sergio Leone
rows.hook: made spaghetti westerns starring a squinting gunslinger with no name

rows.label: Chloé Zhao
rows.hook: directed a Best Picture winner about a woman living out of a van across the West

rows.label: Peter Weir
rows.hook: directed a film about a man whose whole life is a televised show

rows.label: Robert Altman
rows.hook: is known for overlapping dialogue and huge casts, as in a war-hospital satire

rows.label: Yash Chopra
rows.description: Indian film director, script writer and film producer (1932–2012)
rows.hook: directed sweeping Bollywood love stories with songs in Swiss meadows

rows.label: Ken Russell
rows.hook: made flamboyant, provocative films including biopics of famous composers

rows.label: Mike Leigh
rows.hook: develops films through long improvised rehearsals, as in a drama about a woman meeting her birth mother

rows.label: Frank Darabont
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter and producer
rows.hook: directed prison dramas from Stephen King stories, including a rock-hammer escape

rows.label: Garry Marshall
rows.hook: directed a princess-makeover comedy and a Rodeo Drive Cinderella romance

rows.label: Vincente Minnelli
rows.hook: directed classic MGM musicals such as Meet Me in St. Louis and Gigi

rows.label: Wim Wenders
rows.hook: directed Paris, Texas and the Buena Vista Social Club documentary

rows.label: Barry Levinson
rows.description: American screenwriter, film director, actor, and producer
rows.hook: directed Rain Man and Good Morning, Vietnam

rows.label: David O. Russell
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter and producer
rows.hook: directed Silver Linings Playbook and Three Kings

rows.label: John Ford
rows.hook: made countless Westerns set in Monument Valley, often starring the Duke

rows.label: Blake Edwards
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter and producer (1922-2010)
rows.hook: directed the Pink Panther comedies and Breakfast at Tiffany's

rows.label: Joel Schumacher
rows.hook: directed the Batman films Batman Forever and Batman & Robin

rows.label: Todd Phillips
rows.hook: directed The Hangover trilogy and the Joker film starring Joaquin Phoenix

rows.label: Gore Verbinski
rows.hook: directed the first three Pirates of the Caribbean films

rows.label: George Miller
rows.hook: directed the Mad Max series, including Fury Road

rows.label: James L. Brooks
rows.hook: directed Terms of Endearment and As Good as It Gets

rows.label: Georges Méliès
rows.hook: pioneered special effects in early cinema with a film of a rocket landing in the Moon's eye

rows.label: Satoshi Kon
rows.description: Japanese anime director and manga artist (1963–2010)
rows.hook: directed the anime films Perfect Blue and Paprika

rows.label: Rian Johnson
rows.hook: directed Knives Out and Star Wars: The Last Jedi

rows.label: Dario Argento
rows.hook: is a master of stylish horror, known for Suspiria and Deep Red

rows.label: Federico Fellini
rows.hook: directed La Dolce Vita and 8½

rows.label: Cecil B. DeMille
rows.description: American film director, producer and actor (1881–1959)
rows.hook: directed grand Hollywood epics like The Ten Commandments

rows.label: William Hanna
rows.hook: co-created Tom and Jerry and The Flintstones

rows.label: Steve McQueen
rows.description: British film director and video artist (born 1969)
rows.hook: directed 12 Years a Slave, which won the Oscar for Best Picture

rows.label: James Mangold
rows.hook: directed Walk the Line and Logan

rows.label: Roberto Benigni
rows.description: Italian actor, comedian, screenwriter and film director (born 1952)
rows.hook: directed and starred in Life Is Beautiful, winning the Oscar for Best Actor

rows.label: Andrew Stanton
rows.description: American animator, film director and screenwriter (born 1965)
rows.hook: directed the Pixar films Finding Nemo and WALL-E

rows.label: Jonathan Demme
rows.hook: directed The Silence of the Lambs

rows.label: Makoto Shinkai
rows.hook: directed the hit anime Your Name

rows.label: Jean Cocteau
rows.hook: directed the poetic fantasy films Beauty and the Beast and Orpheus, and was also a poet

rows.label: John Boorman
rows.description: British film director, producer and screenwriter
rows.hook: directed Deliverance and Excalibur

rows.label: Roger Corman
rows.hook: was the king of low-budget B-movies, including The Little Shop of Horrors

rows.label: Ed Wood
rows.description: American screenwriter, director, producer, actor, author, and film editor
rows.hook: made Plan 9 from Outer Space, often called the worst film ever made

rows.label: Richard Donner
rows.hook: directed Superman starring Christopher Reeve and the Lethal Weapon series

rows.label: Takeshi Kitano
rows.description: Japanese film director, comedian, singer, actor, film editor, presenter, screenwriter, author, poet, painter and video game designer (born 1947)
rows.hook: directed yakuza films such as Sonatine and Hana-bi, and is also a famous comedian

rows.label: Joseph Barbera
rows.hook: co-created Tom and Jerry and Yogi Bear

rows.label: Wolfgang Petersen
rows.hook: directed the submarine film Das Boot and the epic Troy

rows.label: David Yates
rows.hook: directed the last four Harry Potter films

rows.label: Michael Haneke
rows.hook: directed the unsettling dramas Funny Games and The White Ribbon

rows.label: Anthony Minghella
rows.description: British film director, playwright and screenwriter (1954-2008)
rows.hook: directed The Talented Mr. Ripley and Cold Mountain

rows.label: Hirokazu Koreeda
rows.description: Japanese film director, producer, screenplay writer and film editor (born 1962)
rows.hook: directed Shoplifters, a drama about a makeshift family

rows.label: Ken Loach
rows.hook: makes gritty social-realist dramas like I, Daniel Blake

rows.label: Sammo Hung
rows.description: Hong Kong actor, choreographer, martial artist and filmmaker (born 1952)
rows.hook: is a kung fu star and action choreographer who worked with Jackie Chan

rows.label: Sam Peckinpah
rows.hook: directed the violent Western The Wild Bunch

rows.label: François Truffaut
rows.hook: directed The 400 Blows, a landmark of the New Wave

rows.label: Cristian Mungiu
rows.description: Romanian film director, screenwriter, and film producer (born 1968)
rows.hook: directed 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days, which won the Palme d'Or

rows.label: Mathieu Kassovitz
rows.description: French actor, film director, film producer and screenwriter (born 1967)
rows.hook: directed the black-and-white suburban drama La Haine and acted in Amélie

rows.label: Howard Hawks
rows.description: American film director, producer and screenwriter (1896–1977)
rows.hook: directed Bringing Up Baby and Rio Bravo

rows.label: Zhang Yimou
rows.hook: directed Hero and House of Flying Daggers, and the Beijing Olympics opening ceremony

rows.label: Franco Zeffirelli
rows.hook: directed a famous film version of Romeo and Juliet with teenage leads

rows.label: Joseph L. Mankiewicz
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter, and producer (1909-1993)
rows.hook: directed All About Eve and Cleopatra with Elizabeth Taylor

rows.label: Alan Parker
rows.hook: directed Midnight Express, Fame and Pink Floyd The Wall

rows.label: John Frankenheimer
rows.hook: directed The Manchurian Candidate and Grand Prix

rows.label: Jane Campion
rows.description: New Zealand film director, screenwriter and producer (born 1954)
rows.hook: directed The Piano and was the first woman to win the Palme d'Or

rows.label: Krzysztof Kieślowski
rows.hook: directed the Three Colors trilogy: Blue, White and Red

rows.label: Norman Jewison
rows.description: Canadian film director, producer and actor (1926–2024)
rows.hook: directed In the Heat of the Night and Fiddler on the Roof

rows.label: Alan J. Pakula
rows.description: American film director, writer and producer (1928–1998)
rows.hook: directed All the President's Men and Sophie's Choice

rows.label: Michel Gondry
rows.description: French film director, screenwriter and producer (born 1963)
rows.hook: directed Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind

rows.label: Yasujirō Ozu
rows.hook: directed the quiet family drama Tokyo Story

rows.label: Abbas Kiarostami
rows.description: Iranian film director, screenwriter, photographer and film producer (1940-2016)
rows.hook: directed Taste of Cherry and Close-Up, quiet poetic films

rows.label: Robert Wise
rows.description: American film director, film producer and film editor (1914–2005)
rows.hook: directed both West Side Story and The Sound of Music

rows.label: John G. Avildsen
rows.hook: directed Rocky and The Karate Kid

rows.label: Andrew Niccol
rows.description: New Zealand screenwriter, producer and film director
rows.hook: directed the sci-fi film Gattaca and wrote The Truman Show

rows.label: Carol Reed
rows.hook: directed The Third Man, set in postwar Vienna, and the musical Oliver!

rows.label: James Ivory
rows.hook: directed lavish period dramas like A Room with a View and Howards End
